visual_mood: Futuristic, holographic, high-end automotive, cutting-edge 2026 tech, dark mode with neon iridescent accents.

heading.usage: Hero headers, major section titles, numbers. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, descriptions. Highly legible, geometric.

mono.usage: Order IDs, license plates, timestamps, technical specs, dashboard metrics.

glassmorphism_2_0.usage: Main cards, navigation headers, dashboard widgets. Must have blurred fluid background behind it to create the 'holo' effect.

solid_tech.usage: Input fields, deep background areas, secondary containers.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing, optical alignment, aggressive asymmetry on marketing pages, strict dense grids on dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: The Tetris Grid. Mix col-span-12, col-span-8, col-span-4 to create tension. Break symmetry.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: The Control Room. Dense, data-heavy, col-span-3 or col-span-4. Every pixel utilized.
spacing_and_layout.radii: Use rounded-2xl for main floating panels to mimic glass shards, rounded-md for inner buttons/inputs.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Things appearing and disappearing. Smooth, staggered reveals. High-tech feel.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: framer-motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30, filter: 'blur(10px)' }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)' }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion_and_interactions.loader: ASCII art or pure CSS geometric pulsing loader. Avoid standard spinners.

components_strategy.marketing: Pure Tailwind HTML + Framer Motion. Avoid Shadcn cards to maintain creative freedom. Use overlapping divs and absolute positioning.
components_strategy.dashboard: Shadcn UI deeply customized to match the Glassmorphism 2.0 aesthetic. Strip default white backgrounds, replace with black/40 backdrop-blur.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn inputs and selects but with solid_tech surface styling. Glowing bottom borders on focus.

hero_background.description: Futuristic auto studio. Use as the absolute background for the landing page hero section, overlaid with bg-black/50 gradient.

holo_fluid_background.description: Abstract iridescent fluid. Use this fixed in the background of the dashboard/admin panel. When glassmorphism cards sit on top, it creates the 'holo effect'.

service_ppf.description: Macro shot of PPF application. Use in the services/portfolio section with a slight parallax or hover zoom effect.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure 'Unbounded', 'Outfit', and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts.
Install 'framer-motion' for all appearance/disappearance animations ('lucruri care dispar apar').
Structure the app into three main zones: 1) Marketing Landing Page, 2) Client Dashboard (tracking comenzi), 3) Admin Panel.
Landing Page Hero: Use 'hero_background' with a heavy dark gradient. Typography must be massive (Unbounded text-6xl+).

Holo Effect Implementation: Place the 'holo_fluid_background' as an absolute, fixed layer behind the app content. All overlaying cards/panels must use 'bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl' or 'bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl' so the iridescent fluid bleeds through, creating a futuristic glass UI.
Dashboard: Needs real-time tracking look. Use the 'JetBrains Mono' font for order IDs and license plates. Use vibrant status colors (Cyan, Emerald, Amber) for progress indicators.
Admin Panel: Table-dense but keeps the glassmorphism theme. Include Stripe payment status and WhatsApp notification triggers.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
